source.title: CSL Family Food Connection Food Pantry 2026

questions.label: Do you receive Public Assistance (PA) or Non Public Assistance (NPA)?
questions.note: Asks whether the household gets public assistance now.

questions.label: How old are you?
questions.note: Age in years; no rule or field key gives the applicant's age as a number. Proposed rule: applicantAge.

questions.label: How many children (18 and younger) are in your household? Please fill in 0 if not applicable.
questions.note: Counts children 18 and younger; the profile counts children under 18.

questions.label: How many adults (18-65 years old) are in your household? Please fill in 0 if not applicable.
questions.note: Counts adults 18-65; the profile counts adults 18-64 and seniors 65+.

questions.label: How many senior adults (65 and older) are in your household? Please fill in 0 if not applicable.
By signing up, you confirm that you have reviewed and agree to the terms outlined in the “Application for Receipt of USDA Foods – FD-15A-Part 1.”
questions.note: A single required radio button ("I AGREE"); stored as a one-option checkbox.
